rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something expressing ridicule, especially in descriptions such as a derisive review or tone.

example.english: The tone of this review is very derisive and hardly sounds like a serious critique.
example.traditional: 呢篇影評嘅語氣好嘲諷，完全唔似認真評論。
example.jyutping: ne1 pin1 jing2 ping4 ge3 jyu5 hei3 hou2 zaau1 fung3 jyun4 cyun4 m4 ci5 jing6 zan1 ping4 leon6

rows.note: Use this for pointed, cutting mockery directed at someone, especially in spoken language.

example.english: You don't have to be so derisive toward me; I was only late once.
example.traditional: 你唔使咁挖苦我，我只係遲到一次。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 gam3 waa1 fu2 ngo5 ngo5 zi2 hai6 ci4 dou3 jat1 ci3

rows.note: Use this when the derisive quality comes across as a cheeky or sarcastic attitude or tone.

example.english: Their derisive tone made everyone at the table afraid to speak.
example.traditional: 佢講嘢咁串，搞到成枱人都唔敢出聲。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 je5 gam3 cyun3 gaau2 dou3 seng4 ci4 jan4 dou1 m4 gam2 ceot1 seng1
